notes.title: Major Content Update: New World, Cards, Enemies, Runes, and More...
notes.notes:
Greetings, HOEQ community!

After much hard work, we are thrilled to present version 1.2 of our game. This update brings a new world, numerous community suggestions realized, and fresh content for you to enjoy. Thank you for all the support!

[h2]New Post-Game Mode: Visions of Ascension[/h2]

We’re introducing an additional mode, unlockable after completing the main story “Tower of Shards,” which adds a completely new world: Cyber Nexus. Immerse yourself in this futuristic area, filled with advanced technology and mechanical enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/4064c60784f4d8f5af2d5d49f8a500e9829db5ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/7f048f77e12c2111c53995ed74bdf5998270659a.png[/img]

Explore the [b]Cyber Nexus[/b] and face:

[list]
[*] 10 new enemies with challenging mechanics and an expanded bestiary. 
[*] A new imposing boss with unique abilities. 
[*] Special events that will transform the experience on the new map. 
[*] New resource: Energy Core. This resource can be collected in the Cyber Nexus to unlock new upgrades. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/9951a0a89adc193ae48376786df4c0bd882313be.png[/img]

[h2]New Citadel Upgrades and Building Cards[/h2]

You can use the new resource obtained to unlock new upgrades and building cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/180b57a5487b355658100d4577f9cae540c7c117.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/c993f15511d294eb73cf0d29027b82d6becce9bb.png[/img]

[h2]New Runes[/h2]
With mechanics focused on the use of Golems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/c8fab88c66d0010acc390e53edbb9ed521061bc6.png[/img]

[h2]New Skills and Their Upgrades[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/b6b8578f31cc3d0d603eee0279c81dba1dc51299.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Damage-dealing structures, such as the Watchtower and Rat Tower, now display their damage stats.
[*] Expedition save system: You can now resume the game by saving from the first round of an expedition. 
[/list]

We hope you enjoy all the new content. We will continue working on future updates to provide the best possible experience. Thank you for joining us in this exciting stage of the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes: A minor patch aimed at correcting some translation errors.

notes.title: First Major Content Update: Rune Systems, Bestiary, Skills, and More...
notes.notes:
Greetings, HOEQ community!

We are excited to announce version 1.1 of our game, a major update that integrates valuable player suggestions and new content. Thank you for your support!

[h2]Rune System[/h2]

We introduce equippable runes that offer passive features and add strategic depth, customization, and further progression to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/0f532731d5d067edca8b2774deedc59320b800d8.png[/img]

We have added [b]42 distinct runes[/b] available to enhance the heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/aa6d060189c2adb3026b66f3f858fa7b8d140001.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Crafting System[/h2]

Following your recommendations, we have revamped the crafting system to be more strategic. Items are now permanent, and we have balanced all objects to ensure fair competitiveness in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/b4afeec2b39950a7905a2c91acd2b37d9e0dae80.png[/img]

[h2]Bestiary[/h2]

A compendium of enemies with information about their strengths, weaknesses, abilities, and the resources they offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/9299ca4afc468885100bc8abf331a3642a930dea.png[/img]

[h2]New Skills [/h2]

[b]11[/b] new skills and [b]11[/b] new upgrades available in the runes and for the heroes Alberic and Lionir.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/233f6228029bde50e10d90f7b590642ca2b49a3a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/f251a57091db940d52018d75c2976cd5dd84fb9c.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements and New Features[/h2]

- It is now possible to keep all resources upon completing an expedition.
- Display of progress towards the next skill reward.
- Detail of the characteristics of each summon.
- Option to reshuffle skill rewards for mana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/903e27e7e9ce3cfaf8c3de90f1739b4969226d35.png[/img]

- Separation of defense types in the interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/55ab296c553539d0608efe42ea55664799550c2d.png[/img]

- Aggregation of consumables in a single space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/71e0beed3873a7472f216ded37fefdc49e196ba7.png[/img]

- Improved hero selection with new navigation arrows.
- Enabled zoom for a better view of the citadel improvements.
- Incorporation of avatars for enemies.

[b]Adjustments and Balancing:[/b]

- Adjustments to hero abilities and items to fit the new rune system.
- Changes in specific abilities for heroes and certain constructions.
- Changes in the stats of enemies and bosses.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Fixing issues in certain upgrades that caused unwanted effects.
- Adjustments in descriptions and incorrectly reported damages in some forges.
- Corrections of text errors and sporadic technical issues.
- Removal of obsolete items from the crafting system.

We hope you enjoy the new content. We will continue working on a new update to offer the best gaming experience possible. Thank you for being part of HOEQ and for joining us in this new stage of the game!

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.16c
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to everyone for the bug reports and suggestions!

- We have fixed a bug with the floor 4 boss. There were occasions when it would not trigger the victory screen.
- We have corrected some minor translations in English and Spanish languages.

notes.title: Details of the upcoming content
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We want to express our deep gratitude for the feedback and suggestions we've recently received. We've made several changes to the game's interface and options, aiming to enrich the gaming experience.

We are excited to share with you the path forward for our game, with a series of planned patches and updates that promise to significantly expand and improve the game world. Here we present our roadmap for the upcoming developments:

[b]Rune System:[/b] We will implement a rune system, offering a tree of permanent upgrades accessible from the citadel. This system will allow for the customization of heroes' abilities before each expedition, adding an additional layer of strategy and customization.

[b]Alchemy:[/b] We will introduce an alchemy system that will allow players to break down resources acquired on their adventures to obtain new materials.

[b]New Floors in Extended Gameplay Mode: [/b]For those who have completed the story mode, "The Shattered Tower," we are developing additional floors in a new gameplay mode. This mode will offer renewed challenges and continue the adventure, extending the duration and lifespan of the game.

[b]Gameplay Improvements: [/b]Changes in the resource acquisition system, new items, improvements in the interface, and tutorials.

[b]Steam Deck Compatibility: [/b]We are working on adapting the game's tutorials and shortcuts for comfortable use on Steam Deck.

We are committed to continuous improvement and expansion of the game. Stay tuned for more updates and, as always, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Parche versión 1.0.16b
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for the suggestions and feedback we have received. We've made a minor update to add some features that might be useful.

It is now possible to switch between windowed and full screen modes from the options panel.
You can view the cards in the deck from the deck menu by placing the cursor over one of the right-hand buttons.
We have added some messages for the Critical, Life Steal, Counterattack, and Evasion stats, which can be viewed by hovering over a stat during an expedition. This way, you can more clearly understand how they work.
A message has been added when exiting the game during an expedition. To avoid confusion about the current saving system.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.16a
notes.notes:
- We have fixed a rare bug that only occurred with the hero Alberic when facing the Boss on floor 4, which altered the duration of the Boss's main ability, preventing the completion of the floor with this hero.

We will continue working to review all comments and reports from players. Thank you very much.

notes.title: Finally, Heroes of Eternal Quest is available!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that the full version of Heroes of Eternal Quest is now available. You can now reach the top of The Shattered Tower!

It has been 2 long years of tirelessly working in the development of our game. Therefore, we are very excited that you'll hopefully enjoy the full version and the work we have done. If so, don't forget to leave a review! It would help us tremendously.

[b]Now, what's next?[/b]

We will continue working on content updates and evaluating all kinds of feedback and suggestions to continually enhance the experience in Heroes of Eternal Quest. From a port for Steam Deck to the addition of new mechanics and content that we have planned to include. We are very excited about the upcoming updates we have in store!

[b]Send us your comments![/b]

If you have questions, comments, opinions, or just want to chat with us, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/25xt3QFpMp]Discord[/url]!

[b]Special Thanks[/b]

A special thank you to everyone who has helped us throughout this journey. Sharing ideas, improvements, reporting bugs, testing, and also to everyone who has been eagerly following the project's progress since the Demo launch, making this game possible. Thanks a lot!

notes.title: Heroes of Eternal Quest is about to be released on 23rd!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Heroes![/b]

We are thrilled to announce the official release of Heroes of Eternal Quest. The game will be available on January 23rd!

After two years of dedication and hard work, we are delighted to present you with the full version of our game.

We look forward to seeing you explore the Tower of Fragments and uncover all the secrets we have prepared for you. We want this experience to be as exciting for you as it was for us during development!
After the release, don't forget to leave us your feedback and reviews. We greatly value your opinion and will be continuously working on updates to enhance the Heroes of Eternal Quest experience.

[b]Have Questions or Comments?[/b]

Join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F25xt3QFpMp]Discord[/url] to connect with the community and share your thoughts. We'll be delighted to hear from you.

We appreciate everyone who has been part of this journey, and we hope you enjoy playing Heroes of Eternal Quest as much as we enjoyed creating it!

See you at the Tower of Fragments on January 23rd!

notes.title: Exciting New Enhancements to "Heroes of Eternal Quest" Demo!
notes.notes:
Hey Questers!

We're thrilled to share some game-changing updates for "Heroes of Eternal Quest" demo build. We've been listening to your feedback and have implemented some exciting changes that not only enhance your gaming strategy but also bring a whole new layer of depth to the gameplay. Let's dive in and see what's new!

[b]-Now you can mix weapons; from now on, the equipment card mixing system will be available, - where 2 cards of the same rank will create one of higher rank, improving its statistics.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/245232d1c0d999e14767d8f717516d79ccc21f71.jpg[/img]

[b]-We noticed that most players did not understand what the "Magic Damage" or "Magic Defense" statistics did. Therefore, to improve the gameplay strategy and make weapon mixing more appealing, we created an elemental damage system.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/5ff40dd991f2ec6fc3e67b65f7de4be6df6b9783.jpg[/img]

[b]- Now, magical damage is divided into "Fire Damage," "Ice Damage," "Poison Damage," and "Lightning Damage." Each attribute grants a unique ability, for example, ice damage slows down enemies, and fire damage creates area damage burning enemies. Thus, a player can mix an ice weapon with a fire weapon, benefiting from both attributes. Some enemies are weak against specific elements, so the player can prepare their deck of cards and purchases in the shop depending on each floor of the tower.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/94d02737b813f3f0a83be6ec9cecc072da3bba3d.jpg[/img]

[b]- We have implemented an automatic leveling system where the tower adapts to the player's level, greatly minimizing the luck factor and giving more importance to gameplay strategy. We have also reduced the difficulty level at the beginning of the game.[/b]

[b]- We have added 2 new cards to empower the player at the start of the game, available in the demo.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/565e06ca524285fab768c531bd5c856077aa2d9f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/cbe7b4b347c3088d278c319c0a7d6cc33d96dc9c.jpg[/img]

With these improvements, we believe that the game will largely eliminate the luck factor, enhance gameplay strategy, introduce new cards based on elemental attributes, and increase the appeal of Eternal Quest.

Moving forward, we will be posting updates on game changes and sharing our development progress regularly. Make sure to stay tuned for all the latest news! If what you've read sparks your interest, consider adding "Heroes of Eternal Quest" to your wishlist. We're excited to continue this journey with you all. 

Happy questing!
